name: Donating to Henesys
description:
Arthur, the town clerk, seems to be looking for items needed to manage Henesys. Let's go see Community Board in front of Henesys Town Hall.
Arthur, the town clerk, requested a donation of 30 Tortie Shells for Henesys. Only characters at Level 47 or higher can complete this quest.
I gathered the items requested by Arthur, the town clerk, and brought them to him. I'm glad I could contribute to the development of our town.

name: Donating to Henesys
description:
Arthur, the town clerk, seems to be looking for items needed to manage Henesys. Let's go see Community Board in front of Henesys Town Hall.
Arthur, the town clerk, requested a donation of 30 Drake Skulls for Henesys. Only characters at Level 52 or higher can complete this quest.
I gathered the items requested by Arthur, the town clerk, and brought them to him. I'm glad I could contribute to the development of our town.

name: Bruce's Dilemma
description:
It seems like Bruce, your neighbor living in Henesys, has something on his mind.
Bruce, your neighbor living in Henesys, has been agonizing over how to get his newly found daughter, Ayan, to open her heart to him. It might be best to seek advice from Mrs. Ming Ming. Only characters at Level 17 or higher can complete this quest.
I met with Mrs. Ming Ming to find a way for Bruce, my neighbor living in Henesys, to become closer and open up with his daughter, Ayan.

name: Mrs. Ming Ming's Advice
description:
I need to seek advice from Mrs. Ming Ming on behalf of Bruce in Henesys.
Mrs. Ming Ming in Henesys advised that it is crucial for Bruce to convey his true feelings to his daughter, and suggested that preparing a homemade dish for her would be a great idea. Since Bruce isn't good at cooking, she asked me to deliver a recipe for a dish that Ayan would love. Only characters at Level 17 or higher can complete this quest.
I delivered the recipe written by Mrs. Ming Ming to Bruce.

name: Bruce's Cooking Ingredients
description:
Bruce in Henesys is curious about what advice Mrs. Ming Ming gave.
It seems Bruce in Henesys needs ingredients to make a dish according to Mrs. Ming Ming's Cooking Recipe. You need to bring him the ingredients by defeating monsters or buying them from the town's general store. Only characters at Level 17 or higher can complete this quest.
I brought Bruce in Henesys the ingredients to finish the dish for his daughter. Now all I can do is hope he finishes cooking it well.

name: A Father's Love for His Daughter
description:
It seems Bruce in Henesys wants to express his feelings to his daughter.
Bruce in Henesys asked me to deliver his homemade Bruce's Special Cake to Ayan in Perion. It would be better if he delivered it himself, but... I can understand him being shy. Only characters at Level 17 or higher can complete this quest.
I delivered Bruce's Special Cake to Ayan in Perion. It seems Ayan felt Bruce's sincerity after eating the dish.

name: The Best Dad
description:
It seems Ayan in Perion was moved by her dad's cooking.
After eating her dad's food, I think Ayan in Perion came to understand his true feelings. She then asked me to convey her feelings to Bruce in Henesys. Only characters at Level 17 or higher can complete this quest.
I delivered the heartfelt message from his daughter, Ayan, to Bruce in Henesys. It might take time, but I feel like these two will be able to live happily together from now on.

name: Mrs. Ming Ming's Concern
description:
Mrs. Ming Ming of Henesys seems to have something on her mind.
Mrs. Ming Ming mentioned that although the town festival was a huge success, Chief Stan hasn't been feeling quite like himself lately. She asked for help finding a way to cheer him up, suggesting that Jay, who is well-versed in ancient history, might know something. Only characters at Level 27 or higher can complete this quest.
I went to see Jay in Henesys to seek advice on how to raise Chief Stan's spirits.

name: Chief Stan's Past
description:
Jay of Henesys seems to know a way for Chief Stan to regain his vitality.
Jay of Henesys mentioned that Chief Stan was an adventurer who traveled the world in the past, and suggested that if he could find the Old Chief Stan's Hammer lost long ago when he was young, he might regain his energy. I should inform Mrs. Ming Ming of this information. Only characters at Level 27 or higher can complete this quest.
I passed on Jay's advice to Mrs. Ming Ming of Henesys.

name: Chief Stan's Hammer
description:
Mrs. Ming Ming of Henesys seems to have another request.
Mrs. Ming Ming of Henesys asked me to look for the Old Chief Stan's Hammer for Chief Stan. Will I be able to find it while hunting Evil Eye deep inside the Ant Tunnel Nothing is certain, but if I ever get the chance to go to the Ant Tunnel, I should look for it. Only characters at Level 27 or higher can complete this quest.
I hunted Evil Eye deep inside the Ant Tunnel and finally found the Old Chief Stan's Hammer. I thought it couldn't be found since it was lost decades ago... By the way, Chief Stan really must have been an adventurer in the past.

name: Memories of Youth
description:
Mrs. Ming Ming of Henesys seems to want to deliver good news to Chief Stan.
Mrs. Ming Ming of Henesys asked me to deliver the freshly polished Chief Stan's Hammer to Chief Stan. She seems a bit cautious about handing it over herself.
I delivered the Chief Stan's Hammer to Chief Stan of Henesys, and he was extremely surprised yet overjoyed. Seeing his eyes sparkle like that, it looks as though he might set off on an adventure again right this moment! At any rate, I should report all of this back to Mrs. Ming Ming. Only characters at Level 27 or higher can complete this quest.

name: Regained Vitality
description:
Chief Stan of Henesys seems to have something he wants to tell Mrs. Ming Ming.
Chief Stan of Henesys asked me to tell Mrs. Ming Ming that he is sorry and grateful. However, the news that he has regained his vitality will likely be what makes her happiest. Only characters at Level 27 or higher can complete this quest.
I delivered Chief Stan's message to Mrs. Ming Ming of Henesys. She seems relieved and ready to prepare for the next town festival.

name: A Gift for Pia
description:
Camila of Henesys seems to have something on her mind.
I met Camila in Henesys, and it looks like she's fretting over a birthday present for yet another friend of hers in town, Pia. The trouble is, Pia is quite picky about her tastes, so Camila asked me to go find out what she'd like to receive. I hear I can find Pia over at Henesys Park. Only characters at Level 37 or higher can complete this quest.
I asked Pia what she'd like for her birthday, but she doesn't seem like she's about to give me a simple answer.

name: Pia's Mischievous Wish
description:
Pia over at Henesys Park seems to be mulling over what she'd like for her birthday present.
I met Pia at Henesys Park, and with a mischievous look on her face, she said what she'd really like as a birthday present is a Sparkling Glass Marble. The trouble is, that's the very same precious item Camila once gave to Utah as a birthday present... I'd better head back to Camila first. Only characters at Level 37 or higher can complete this quest.
Camila was taken aback to hear what Pia wants for her birthday.

name: Materials for a Special Marble
description:
Camila of Henesys seems to be worrying a great deal over Pia's birthday present.
It looks like Camila has decided to make a prettier, sturdier marble for Pia. For Camila's sake, let's head down into the Kerning City subway or the depths of the Ant Tunnel, defeat some Jr. Boogie 1 or Jr. Boogie 2, and gather Jr. Boogie Horn. Only characters at Level 37 or higher can complete this quest.
I brought Camila the item she asked for. Still, no matter how I look at it, it really seems like Pia is just trying to mess with Camila.

name: A Marble Made With Care
description:
Camila of Henesys seems to have finished the birthday present for Pia.
Camila asked me to deliver the birthday present to Pia on her behalf. Since it isn't the exact item Pia said she wanted, Camila seems quite worried about it. Still, it must've just been my imagination that Pia seemed to be thinking about Utah. Only characters at Level 37 or higher can complete this quest.
I delivered Camila's birthday present to Pia. Now that she's received it, Pia seems somehow flustered.

name: A Promise Between Three Friends
description:
Pia over at Henesys Park seems to have something she wants to tell Camila.
When I met Pia at Henesys Park, it turned out she was just a girl who wasn't very good at being honest about her feelings. Too embarrassed, or something like that. Still, somehow I think I understand how she feels. Pia asked me to go tell Camila that the two of them should visit Utah's farm together sometime. Those two are pretty cute, aren't they Only characters at Level 37 or higher can complete this quest.
I passed along Pia's suggestion to Camila at Henesys. I'm already curious to see what's in store for the three of them — Camila, Pia, and Utah.

name: An Unknown Savior
description:
Maya, who lives in the little mushroom house in Henesys, seems to have something on her mind.
Maya, who lives in the little mushroom house in Henesys, said that a while back, she wandered a bit further from town than usual to pick some delicious mushrooms, and stumbled upon a giant mushroom monster that put her in grave danger — until a warrior appeared out of nowhere and saved her. She wants to track him down and repay his kindness, but he vanished the moment he'd saved her, and she's had no way of finding him since. She's hoping I can help her find some clue. To find any leads, I should probably start by heading to the place where it all happened. It seems I need to look for the Giant Mushroom somewhere at Someone Else's House in Henesys. I suppose I'll have to take it down Only characters at Level 47 or higher can complete this quest.
I defeated the Giant Mushroom, Mushmom, that I encountered at Someone Else's House, and found Torn Note, which I brought back to Maya. Could this be a clue that leads me to that person

name: A Name on a Note
description:
Maya, who lives in the little mushroom house in Henesys, seems to want to follow the clue written on Torn Note.
From Torn Note, which I obtained after defeating Mushmom, the one who'd attacked Maya, I picked up two leads: Ellinia and Chrishrama. I think it'd be best to head to Sleepywood first and go hear what Chrishrama has to say. Only characters at Level 47 or higher can complete this quest.
I met Chrishrama at Sleepywood. It seems I might be able to track down the warrior who saved Maya more easily than I thought.

name: A Price to Pay
description:
Chrishrama, who I met at Sleepywood, seems to be hiding something.
Chrishrama, who I met at Sleepywood, wouldn't say a word, insisting that person wouldn't want to be known — but worn down by my persistent pleading, he reluctantly set one condition. That condition was for me to bring him Drake Skull for his research. It seems I should be able to get Drake Skulls by defeating Copper Drakes, found far off from Perion, or Drakes deep within the Ant Tunnel. Only characters at Level 47 or higher can complete this quest.
I handed over the Drake Skulls to Chrishrama, who I met at Sleepywood. Now it's time to hear his story about the warrior who saved Maya.

name: A Man Atoning
description:
It seems Chrishrama, who I met at Sleepywood, is finally about to reveal the secret.
Chrishrama, who I met at Sleepywood, told me to go find a man standing at the top of Perion. He clearly seems to know more than he's letting on, but for now he seems to be holding his tongue. Let's go find that warrior at Perion. Only characters at Level 47 or higher can complete this quest.
I met Manji at Perion. I don't think I've ever seen him look so flustered before.

name: A Name Never Given
description:
The warrior Maya had been searching for turned out to be Manji of Perion.
When I told Manji of Perion that Maya was looking for the one who'd saved her life, he seemed to waver for a moment — but then asked me to keep his secret, saying he didn't want her to know who he was. I wonder what I should tell Maya when I go back to her... Only characters at Level 47 or higher can complete this quest.
I returned to Maya at Henesys and told her what I'd learned about the one who'd saved her life. She seemed a little disappointed, but somehow looked happy all the same.

name: Becoming a Citizen of Honor
chain: A Gift for a Citizen of Honor
description:
I've finally been recognized as a Citizen of Honor of Henesys.
It seems Athena Pierce, who leads the town, is looking for me, so I should probably head over right away. Only characters at Level 57 or higher can complete this quest.
Athena Pierce of Henesys personally congratulated me on becoming a Citizen of Honor.

name: A Box Hidden Long Ago
chain: A Gift for a Citizen of Honor
description:
It seems Athena Pierce of Henesys has something to tell me now that I've become a Citizen of Honor.
Athena Pierce of Henesys said there was a gift prepared for me for becoming a Citizen of Honor, but that she'd give it to me if I could do her one favor first. She told me that a long, long time ago, she'd hidden a small box containing a bow somewhere in the Golem's Temple, but when she recently went to retrieve it, it was gone — and she asked me to go find that box for her. I wonder if Stone Golem or Dark Stone Golem out there might have it. Only characters at Level 57 or higher can complete this quest.
Why would Athena Pierce have hidden this box in a place like that, I wonder

name: A Worn-Out Bow
chain: A Gift for a Citizen of Honor
description:
It seems Athena Pierce of Henesys has yet another favor to ask.
Inside Athena Pierce's box was a small, old bow. But it had fallen apart after all that time, and Athena Pierce said Vicious should be able to fix it. It seems I should head to Vicious at Henesys Market and show them the bow. Still, if this bow is centuries old, just how many long years has Athena Pierce been alive for Only characters at Level 57 or higher can complete this quest.
I showed Broken Wooden Bow to Vicious. I hope he's able to fix it...

name: A Craftsman's Touch
chain: A Gift for a Citizen of Honor
description:
Can Vicious at Henesys Market fix Athena Pierce's bow
Vicious said the Broken Wooden Bow is made from a rare wood hardly ever found on Victoria Island, and asked me to gather Dragon Skin and Fragment of Magic as materials to repair the bow. It seems Dragon Skin can be obtained from Copper Drake, Drake, and Red Drake, while Fragment of Magic can be obtained from monsters imbued with magical energy, such as Malady, Stone Golem, and Dark Stone Golem. Only characters at Level 57 or higher can complete this quest.
I brought Vicious all the materials needed to repair the bow.

name: A Memory Restored
chain: A Gift for a Citizen of Honor
description:
It seems Vicious is about to show off his skill.
Vicious of Henesys Market, true to his reputation as the town's finest craftsman, repaired Athena Pierce's bow to perfection. All that's left now is to bring this Repaired Wooden Bow back to Athena Pierce. Only characters at Level 57 or higher can complete this quest.
I brought Repaired Wooden Bow to Athena Pierce and got to hear her story. That bow once belonged to a friend of hers from back when even Athena Pierce herself was still young and inexperienced — he'd passed away in a war fought centuries ago, and Athena Pierce had kept his bow all this time to remember him by. Athena Pierce thanked me for helping her recover a bow that held such precious memories, and gave me a small gift in return. I should treasure this Henesys Earrings she gave me too.

name: The Right to Own a Home
description:
Arthur of Henesys Town Hall seems to have a new offer for me.
Arthur of Henesys Town Hall said he had some good news, and told me that I'd been granted the right to own a house in this town. To hear more details, I should go find Tommy.
Tommy of Henesys Town Hall told me all about houses.

name: Looking for a House
description:
It seems Tommy of Henesys Town Hall has something more to tell me about houses.
Tommy of Henesys Town Hall suggested that if I want to get a house, I should go see Bianca. I should be able to find Bianca on the east side of Henesys.
It seems I can buy a house from Bianca of Henesys. I'll have to remember that.

name: To the Gray City, Kerning City
description:
Arthur, the Town Clerk of Henesys, seems to have another proposal.
Town Clerk Arthur of Henesys recommended listening to the explanation in Kerning City as well before deciding which city to become a resident of. Only characters at Level 12 or higher can complete this quest.
City Clerk Roxy, whom I met in Kerning City, suggested that I become a resident of Kerning City. Which city suits me better, Henesys or Kerning City Once I make up my mind, I should speak with the City Clerk of that city for more details.

name: First Greeting with Alex, the Town Resident
description:
It looks like Roxy, the City Clerk, is looking for someone to help with her work. Let's go check out Community Board in front of Kerning City Civic Center.
Roxy, the City Clerk, asked me to greet Alex, a resident of the city. Since I've become a resident here too, greeting the cityspeople is a given, right Only characters at Level 12 or higher can complete this quest.
I greeted Alex, a resident of Kerning City. As expected, the residents of this city seem to be quite full of personality.

name: Asking After Alex, the Town Resident
description:
It looks like Roxy, the City Clerk, is looking for someone to help with her work. Let's go check out Community Board in front of Kerning City Civic Center.
Roxy, the City Clerk, asked me to check on Alex, a resident of the city. Let's go see how Alex is doing. Only characters at Level 12 or higher can complete this quest.
I checked on Alex, a resident of Kerning City. In a city like this, no news is the best news.
